title: OS & GPU driver version is hidden when using Linux Steam runtimes
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]
v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
v4.0.4.stable.official [fc0b241c9]

Steam Runtime 1 (scout) (reported as soldier because it is wrapped with soldier)
Steam Runtime 2 (soldier)
Steam Runtime 3 (sniper)

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (nvidia; 580.95.05) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.47 GiB memory

### Issue description

Copy System Info button
On Steam v4.5.1:
`Godot v4.5.1.stable - Steam Runtime 2 (soldier) 2 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (nvidia) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.47 GiB memory` 
Off Steam v4.5.1:
`Godot v4.5.1.stable - Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (nvidia; 580.95.05) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.47 GiB memory`

```gd
print(OS.get_name(), " - ", OS.get_distribution_name(), " - ", OS.get_version(), " - ", OS.get_version_alias(), " - Driver: ", OS.get_video_adapter_driver_info())
```
On Steam v4.5.1:
`Linux - Steam Runtime 2 (soldier) - 2 - 2 - Driver: ["nvidia", ""]`

Off Steam v4.5.1:
`Linux - Linux Mint - 22.2 (Zara) - 22.2 (Zara) - Driver: ["nvidia", "580.95.05"]`


### Steps to reproduce

Run the Godot Engine at https://store.steampowered.com/app/404790/Godot_Engine/ with Linux Runtime (not Proton) and copy system info or run the following code (included in MRP)
```gd
print(OS.get_name(), " - ", OS.get_distribution_name(), " - ", OS.get_version(), " - ", OS.get_version_alias(), " - Driver: ", OS.get_video_adapter_driver_info())
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[new-game-project-4.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23243180/new-game-project-4.zip)
